recommendation: Keep the source fix. It makes the current build-scope Appointment search parameter bundle match the final PA decision without changing unrelated search parameters.
issue_request: FHIR-25419 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for Appointment. It requested support for searching booked appointments by Appointment.start and proposed appointments by Appointment.requestedPeriod in one query; the approved resolution introduced date-or-req-period using (start | requestedPeriod.start).first(), introduced requestedPeriod/requested-period search support, and stated that the existing date parameter should remain unchanged.
initial_application: The original application commit ab4f934ab55e8d49013bee2756041fa2c6078d53 changed Appointment-date from Appointment.start to the combined requestedPeriod expression, which contradicted the resolution's unchanged-date instruction. The tightly related FHIR-20532 commit 6879287a594dd95d4c49d2962b1791dc0fdd4824 added requested-period, so the remaining gap was the missing date-or-req-period parameter and the altered date expression.
additional_context: Appointment is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/appointment/bundle-Appointment-search-params.xml is the current source for Appointment search parameters. The origin Zulip thread records the implementer need to search booked and proposed appointments together, PA minutes record the FHIR-25419 persuasive-with-modification vote, and later discussion of requested-period treated date as Appointment.start and requested-period as Appointment.requestedPeriod. No later conflicting Jira decision was found in bounded Appointment search-parameter searches.
reconciliation: Changed source/appointment/bundle-Appointment-search-params.xml so Appointment-date again uses Appointment.start, then added Appointment-date-or-req-period with code date-or-req-period, path Appointment.start,Appointment.requestedPeriod.start, and expression (start | requestedPeriod.start).first(). Left the existing requested-period parameter unchanged because it already supplies the requestedPeriod search capability.

related_jiras.note: Independently approved and applied the Appointment requested-period search parameter that FHIR-25419 also referenced.
Added multipleOr and multipleAnd flags to Appointment search parameters; the new parameter follows that current-source pattern.
